title: The Raven and the Swan variant
summary: A raven washed in clear mountain streams hoping to turn his black plumage white, but died of cold, leaving his black feathers unchanged....

full_text: A raven washed in clear mountain streams hoping to turn his black plumage white, but died of cold, leaving his black feathers unchanged.
moral: No stream can wash away what nature has ordained.
